high_level_goal.name: Ensure timely evaluation and decision-making on supplier proposals
high_level_goal.description: Provide administrators with tools to evaluate supplier proposals within defined timeframes, including automatic rejection for delays, to maintain operational efficiency and product quality.

actor.name: Administrator
actor.description: Staff member responsible for evaluating supplier proposals, managing automatic reorders, and overseeing system operations.

low_level_goals.name: Administrator reviews supplier proposal and assigns status
low_level_goals.description: The administrator evaluates the proposal and assigns one of three statuses: accepted, revisions requested with a comment, or rejected.

high_level_associated.name: Ensure timely evaluation and decision-making on supplier proposals

low_level_goals.name: System auto-rejects proposal if evaluation deadline is exceeded
low_level_goals.description: The system automatically marks and rejects proposals that exceed the ten-working-day evaluation deadline, and notifies the supplier.

high_level_associated.name: Ensure timely evaluation and decision-making on supplier proposals

low_level_goals.name: System notifies supplier of evaluation outcome
low_level_goals.description: The system sends a notification to the supplier informing them of the evaluation result (accepted, revisions requested, or rejected) after the administrator assigns a status.
